question: Who among the following was the first Chief Election Commissioner of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sukumar Sen.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sukumar Sen:-**

 
 
• He​ was appointed as the** first Chief Election Commissioner of India** in **1950,** when the Election Commission of India was established.
 
 
 
• Election Commission of India:-
 
 
• ​It is an autonomous constitutional body responsible for conducting free and fair elections in India.
 
• It was established on 25th January 1950, and Sukumar Sen was appointed as the first Chief Election Commissioner of India.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Informations__**

 
• Dr. Nagendra Singh:-

 
 
• He was a former Chief Justice of India and served as the judge of the International Court of Justice.
 
• He was not the first Chief Election Commissioner of India.
 
 
 
• SP Sen Verma:-
 
 
• He was a former Deputy Speaker of the Lok Sabha and a member of the Constituent Assembly.
 
• He was also not the first Chief Election Commissioner of India.
 
 
 
• KVK Sundaram:-
 
 
• He was a former Chief Secretary of the state of Uttar Pradesh and served as the Chief Election Commissioner of India from 1986 to 1990.
 
• He was not the first Chief Election Commissioner of India.
